good_thing: (Spring Valley, California): Teddy, a white poodle missing for more than 30 days, was rescued from a storm drain by San Diego County Animal Services. Officer Britney Myers climbed in through a manhole and coaxed Teddy out with treats. After being cleaned, fed, vaccinated, and scanned at the shelter, Teddy was reunited with her owner that same day, with tail wags and howls.
current_or_history: On August 21, 1911, the Mona Lisa was stolen from the Louvre in Paris on an exceptionally hot day. Former Louvre employee Vincenzo Perugia kept the painting for two years before it was recovered in Florence in December 1913.
tiny_fact: Scientists can spot some penguin colonies from space by looking for distinctive guano stains in satellite imagery.
thought: You do not have to solve the whole week today; one small good turn is plenty.
